cache.title: Prompt cache reuse

statusHint.high: Most context is being served from the cache (latest run {{latest}}).
statusHint.moderate: Some context is reused from the cache (latest run {{latest}}).
statusHint.low: Little context is reused from the cache (latest run {{latest}}).
statusHint.dropped: The latest run reused {{latest}} of its context, versus {{baseline}} usually. One low run is not proof the cache was lost; check the causes below.
statusHint.insufficient: Paperclip needs a few measurable runs before judging cache reuse.

insufficient.few_runs: Fewer than three runs with enough context to measure.
insufficient.not_reported: This integration does not report cache counters, so reuse cannot be measured.

cache.savings: ≈ {{amount}} API-equivalent saved by the cache over the last {{runs}} runs.
cache.possibleCauses: Visible changes on the latest run

cause.new_session: It started a new session, so earlier context had to be sent again.
cause.model_changed: The model changed; each model has its own cache.
cause.long_gap: It started {{minutes}} min after the previous run; the default cache lasts 5 minutes.
cause.unknown: No change is visible in the run records. The provider may have evicted the cache, or the start of the context changed.

cache.tip: Switching models or editing the beginning of an agent's instructions makes the next runs start without cache. The cache lives on the provider side for a limited time; Paperclip does not send keep-alive calls.
cache.modelChangeWarning: Changing the model starts a new prompt cache: the next runs will process the full context again at the uncached input price.
